entries.03308d4e96b8db36: This core business operates scheduled passenger and cargo shipping routes linking the Tokyo Islands and the mainland, and sightseeing cruises within Tokyo Bay. Consolidated subsidiary Ogasawara Kaiun operates the scheduled route linking Tokyo and Ogasawara (Chichijima), Izu Shichito Kaiun handles cargo transport, and consolidated subsidiaries on each island provide shipping agency services, onboard services and ship repair centered on jetfoil maintenance.
